title: Lane lints in parallel finish under the 1200 s cap
why: More than about 3 lane lints at once hit the 1200 s cap (lane batch63-lint-b, coordinator 00:29 CST Nov 8). Steps merge-builds-batches and runner-repos-in-parallel do not cover it: they build batches and run repos in parallel, and set no lint concurrency.
note: Fix: lane lint takes a slot from a small shared limit and waits for one, so a run's cap counts its own work, not the queue; red case first with four parallel lints. The count of about 3 is unmeasured. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the coordinator. Filed 00:31 CST Nov 8.
